author: oO EezO Oo
body:
I was just checking out some of the reviews for Ikaruga and some of the videos look great.  They got the whole Ying and Yang thing goin in this game.  And you can upload / download high videos and high score videos off the leaderboards... pretty cool stuff if you get hung up in a certain spot.  I'm willing to overlook the lack of Boost Start for this one.  IGN gave it editors choice.

CAPS LOCK - Cruise control for AWESOME!!
